PART III – LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
No. 2441/08 – TUESDAY, JUNE 17, 2025
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Order under proviso (a) to Section 38
Order No. 30 of 2025
My Ref. No. : 4-3/07/2020/HW/168.Divisional Secretary’s Ref. No.: DIVNA/LND/LA/ACQUI/4/1/34

By virtue of the powers vested in me by Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460), I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation do hereby direct the Acquiring Officer or any other officer authorised by him referred to in Paragraph of the I Schedule to take immediate possession of the land specified in the corresponding entry in paragraph II of that Schedule.
K.D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation.
Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation,"Mihikatha Medura", No.1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla,09th April, 2025.
